name: vigo
description: Visual Intelligence for GTFS Operations: inspect, compile, route, and analyze scheduled transit networks.

scripts.batch:routing: npm run build:cli --silent && node dist-cli/vigo.mjs route
scripts.benchmark:smoke: npm run build:rust-routing-kernel --silent && npm run build:cli --silent && node benchmarks/smoke.mjs

scripts.check:routing: npm run check:rust-routing-ownership --silent && npm run check:scenario-overlay-csa --silent && npm run check:accessibility-range --silent && npm run check:scenario-analysis --silent && node scripts/check-single-router-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-national-state-identity.mjs && node scripts/check-national-kernel-certification.mjs && npm run check:store-admission --silent && npm run check:national --silent && npm run check:national-choices --silent
scripts.check:security: node scripts/check-local-http-security.mjs && node scripts/check-limited-response-body.mjs && node scripts/check-realtime-url-security.mjs && node scripts/check-cch-manifest.mjs
scripts.check:national-runtime: node scripts/check-national-derived-artifact-lifecycle.mjs && node scripts/check-national-cache-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-national-prewarm-lifecycle.mjs && node scripts/check-national-runtime-isolation.mjs && node scripts/check-national-memory-pressure.mjs && npm run check:national-focused --silent

scripts.check:public: node scripts/check-node-runtime.mjs && node scripts/check-public-release.mjs && npm run check:docs --silent && npm run check:source-safety --silent && npm run check:maintainability --silent
scripts.check:dev: npm run check:rust-routing-targets --silent && npm run build:rust-routing-kernel --silent && npm run typecheck --silent && npm run check:security --silent && npm run check:ui --silent && npm run check:map --silent && npm run check:gtfs --silent && npm run check:routing --silent && npm run check:cli --silent
scripts.check:release-runtime:portable: npm run check:ui --silent && npm run check:map --silent && npm run check:gtfs --silent && npm run check:routing --silent && npm run check:national-runtime --silent && npm run check:cli --silent && npm run check:atlas --silent
scripts.check:release: npm run check:public --silent && npm run build:rust-routing-kernel --silent && npm run check:release-runtime --silent
scripts.test: npm run check:public --silent && npm run check:dev --silent
scripts.build: npm run build:rust-routing-kernel --silent && tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:cli
scripts.standalone:macos: npm run icons:macos && npm run build && npm run clean:caches --silent && npm run check:release --silent && npm run package:macos
scripts.release:macos: npm run standalone:macos && npm run archive:macos && npm run check:macos-release --silent
